Clean peak Owner EPS of $11.95 in FY2025 with ~91% FCF conversion. 5-10Y bottom-up growth of 6.5% reflects 2.0% net restaurant additions, 2.5% comp sales/pricing, 1.0% digital/loyalty mix, -0.5% franchisee margin relief, and 1.5% ongoing share repurchases.
